title: I’ve been writing down my dreams every morning for a month
content: Ive never tried keeping track of the places I go to in my dreams, but thought I would try writing them down for awhile because they are always so vivid upon awakening. I’ve never given them much thought, and they melt away after a few minutes of being awake. But after writing them down, it is unsettling that I return to the same place every night, the same people are always there. It’s creeping me out, has anyone else had this experience?
